entries.063fce3296876086: In its main tugboat business, the company implemented a revision of tugboat rates commensurate with increasing costs in May 2025, and going forward it will advance efficiency through reduction of operating crew, optimization of fleet size, and introduction of a vessel allocation support system using AI. On the environmental side, using knowledge gained from operation of a hybrid electric propulsion tugboat that entered service in 2023, it aims to introduce a pure battery tugboat by around 2030. It plans to grow the business for offshore wind power generation as one of its main businesses, and will work on business development for SOVs and other vessels in addition to crew transfer vessels (CTV) and on education and training of seafarers. In the passenger vessel business, Tokyo Bay Ferry plans to replace vessels through bareboat charter of a newly built vessel from autumn 2027.
entries.0921943d5ada2efc: Main customers are operators of vessels entering and leaving ports in Tokyo Bay, operators that construct and maintain offshore wind power generation, and passengers who use the car ferry.
entries.0957d707d4099afe: In the tugboat business, it operates tugboat services that assist large vessels in berthing and unberthing and pilot boats; in the marine-related business, it operates crew transfer vessels (CTV) for offshore wind power generation and ship chartering; and in the passenger ship business, it operates a car ferry connecting Kurihama and Kanaya.
entries.3179a4799d401d28: This is a business model in which the company operates marine-related businesses such as operation of crew transfer vessels for offshore wind power generation, centered on tugboat services, and passenger ship businesses such as car ferries, and earns revenue from fees for operation services and passenger fares.

entries.62bc94f643607638: This business is operated by consolidated subsidiary Tokyo Wan Ferry Co., Ltd., which runs car ferries connecting Kurihama Port in Kanagawa Prefecture and Kanaya Port in Chiba Prefecture.
